edit.description: Two vacuous judgements over the retired `coverage.unmodeled-surface` id. In `a_mcp_json_is_governed_whole_by_the_container_rather_than_by_this_segment_kind` (tests/it/mcp_server_kind.rs:167) the `let unmodeled = common::findings_for(..)` binding and the `.all(|line| !line.contains(".mcp.json"))` assertion over it both go; the case's real subject is the `mcp (1)` / `mcp-server (2)` disclosure pins below, which stay. In `a_program_declaring_only_servers_leaves_the_containers_document_undeclared` (tests/it/mcp_server_kind.rs:201) the `is_empty()` assertion over the whole class goes; its subject is the one `root.locus-declared` finding below. Trim each case's doc comment to the claim that survives — neither may keep promising a silence no code can break.

The same vacuous `is_empty()` judgement at tests/it/mcp_kind.rs:286, inside `the_servers_under_mcp_servers_stay_mcp_server_members_rather_than_container_fields`, with the comment above it claiming a "gap left to name". Both go; the case keeps its `mcp (1)` / `mcp-server (1)` count pins as its subject.

summary: No test judges the retired `coverage.unmodeled-surface` id: three assertions over a finding class no code can emit are green over zero subject.

per.section: A green verdict is proven non-vacuous
